desc: Ideation and problem analysis (Core difficulty identified: Manhattan distance on boundary requires Interval Graph MIS, not simple greedy).
Sorting points along the perimeter of the square.

Implement the full solution in the `Solution` class, including the perimeter sorting, the `check` function using the Interval Graph MIS greedy approach (with two-pointers for interval construction), and the binary search loop.
Verify the perimeter traversal logic (bottom, right, top, left) correctly orders points.
Verify the two-pointer logic for finding intervals handles the circular nature correctly.
